name: WE_CircuitSAT
title: Witness encryption for NAND-circuit SAT (128 inputs, 2^12 gates), lambda = kappa = 128
description: The concrete witness-encryption problem: AdvancedEncryption.WE.CircuitSAT.P is WE (Def_WE) for the satisfiability of NAND circuits with 128 input bits and 2^12 gates (statements in the gate-list format of SigabaNeo.evalGates, witnesses the 128-bit assignments), at lambda = kappa = 128. Registry R: decision LWE, Ring-LWE, Module-LWE and circular Ring-LWE with automorphism keys from SigabaNeoStd. SubmissionProp := Spec P R is what Design AI proves. Sanity lemmas: a circuit no assignment satisfies and one every assignment satisfies.
